cohort: 100 nulliparous pregnant women undergoing cesarean section under spinal anesthesia
finding: While tenoxicam reduced the incidence and severity of bradycardia, chest tightness, shoulder discomfort, and abdominal discomfort during cesarean section, it did not significantly reduce nausea and vomiting.
mod_finding: Tenoxicam reduced the incidence and severity of various discomforts during cesarean section, but not nausea and vomiting.
